description: Search, filter, price, and availability data for Verkkokauppa.com, Finland's largest consumer-electronics retailer.

tools.name: fi_get-availability
tools.description: Returns per-store and per-channel stock, purchase eligibility and flags (sold out, preorder, in campaign) for one or more product ids. Required: pids.

tools.name: fi_search-products
tools.description: Returns product search results. Prices and basic availability flags are embedded in each product; facets (category, price range, brand, etc.) are returned in `included`. A `sessionId` (any UUID) is required. Required: sessionId. Optional: filter_q, filter_category, filter_price (plus 4 more).

params.name: filter_category
params.description: Category facet key to narrow results (e.g. information_technology)

params.name: sessionId
params.description: Any UUID identifying the browsing session

tools.name: info_get-product
tools.description: Returns price, discount, brand and category breadcrumbs for one or more product ids. Required: pids.
